purpose: Fast lookup guide for running quality tests and resolving clarifications

run_all_tests.command: python3 -c "from src.infrastructure.brittleness_ambiguity_validator import BrittlenessAmbiguityValidator; v = BrittlenessAmbiguityValidator(); r = v.validate_before_execution(); print(f'Score: {r.overall_design_score:.1f}/100')"
run_all_tests.when: Before any AC-ID implementation, phase transition, or on-demand
run_all_tests.output: Design score + halt status + clarifications needed

run_ambiguity_only.when: Quick check for vague terms in AC descriptions

check_state_sync.command: python3 -c "import yaml, json; ac = yaml.safe_load(open('cortex-brain/tier1/acceptance-criteria/AC-INDEX.yaml')); mp = yaml.safe_load(open('cortex-brain/cx6-plan/master-plan.yaml')); print('✅ SYNCED' if ac['total_ac_count'] == mp['total_ac_ids'] else '❌ MISMATCH')"
check_state_sync.when: Before plan alignment or after AC-INDEX changes

generate_report.command: python3 -c "from src.infrastructure.brittleness_ambiguity_validator import BrittlenessAmbiguityValidator; v = BrittlenessAmbiguityValidator(); r = v.validate_before_execution(ac_id='AC-ORCH-007'); print(f'Report saved to: cortex-brain/tier1/evidence-bundles/AC-ORCH-007/')"
generate_report.when: After resolving clarifications, for evidence bundle
generate_report.output: YAML report with scores and test results

design_score_below_target.message: Design score degraded below target. Review and fix before proceeding.
design_score_below_target.fix: Run tests, resolve clarifications, re-run until score >= 95

high_brittleness.message: Critical brittleness detected. Fix hardcoded dependencies, circular deps, or error handling.
fix: Remove circular imports using dependency injection
Add file locking for concurrent access

high_ambiguity.message: High ambiguity detected. Answer clarification questions to proceed.
fix: Replace vague terms with measurable metrics
Add missing error scenarios and edge cases
Resolve status conflicts between plan files
Define all acronyms and domain terms

incomplete_dor.message: Definition of Ready incomplete. Complete all DoR criteria.
fix: Search git history for existing implementations

step_1_detect.output: List of detected issues with severity

step_2_generate.action: Generate clarification questions for each issue

format.question: Clarify: 'fast' in file cortex-brain/tier1/acceptance-criteria/AC-INDEX.yaml
format.recommended_answer: Replace with specific metric: '<200ms response time'
format.rationale: Ambiguous terms reduce clarity and testability. CORTEX 6 requires measurable criteria.

options.S: Skip this issue (document as technical debt)

missing_error_handling.fix: Add specific exception handling, validate inputs, add retries

state_management_issues.fix: Use file locking, synchronize plan files, wrap in transactions

test_coverage_gaps.fix: Increase coverage, add integration tests, remove hardcoded sleeps

missing_specifications.fix: Document error handling, edge cases, performance SLAs

undefined_terms.fix: Define on first use or add to cortex-brain/tier0/governance/glossary.yaml

all_answers_are: Aligned with CORTEX 6.0 plan and vision
Based on existing governance rules (CORE, Tier 0-3)

hardcoded_path.question: Replace hardcoded absolute path with portable Path()?
hardcoded_path.rationale: CORE-005 Path Portability: Cross-platform compatibility, works in CI/CD

vague_term_fast.issue: Detected: 'fast response time' in AC-ORCH-007 description
vague_term_fast.question: Replace 'fast' with specific threshold?
vague_term_fast.rationale: DoR Clarity: Measurable criteria enable testability and validation

missing_error_handling.issue: Detected: No error scenario in AC-TODO-002
missing_error_handling.question: Document error handling approach?
missing_error_handling.recommended_answer: YES - 'On circular dependency: raise ValidationError, log to audit, block task creation'
missing_error_handling.rationale: DoR Completeness: Error scenarios are required for production readiness

ac_count_mismatch.issue: Detected: AC-INDEX.yaml shows 97 AC-IDs, master-plan.yaml shows 95
ac_count_mismatch.question: Synchronize to AC-INDEX.yaml (source of truth)?
ac_count_mismatch.rationale: Ambiguity Reduction: Single source of truth prevents conflicting requirements

missing_test_coverage.question: Add tests to reach 80% coverage?
missing_test_coverage.recommended_answer: YES - Add integration tests for: routing, middleware, error handling, correlation propagation
missing_test_coverage.rationale: Brittleness Reduction: Low coverage increases fragility and regression risk

common_issues_and_fixes.symptoms: Tests fail, clarifications required, halt execution
common_issues_and_fixes.diagnosis: Run: validator.validate_before_execution() to see failing tests
common_issues_and_fixes.fix: Resolve clarifications, fix brittleness issues, re-run tests
common_issues_and_fixes.prevention: Run tests before every AC-ID implementation

common_issues_and_fixes.diagnosis: Check: AC-INDEX.yaml total_ac_count vs master-plan.yaml total_ac_ids
common_issues_and_fixes.fix: Synchronize to AC-INDEX.yaml (source of truth), update all plan files
common_issues_and_fixes.prevention: Use state synchronization on every turn
Add pre-commit hook to detect hardcoded paths

common_issues_and_fixes.fix: Answer all clarification questions, complete DoR checklist
common_issues_and_fixes.prevention: Run DoR validation before starting any AC-ID
Use recommended answers for all clarifications
